description: This file implements Windows-specific network change notification logic for Chromium, including connection type detection, event handling, and integration with Windows network management interfaces.

classes.name: NetworkCostManagerEventSink
classes.description: Implements event sink for Windows network cost management notifications, calling a callback on cost change.

methods.name: GetConnectionPoints
methods.description: Retrieves the connection point for a COM interface.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::NetworkChangeCalculatorParamsWin
methods.description: Returns network change delay parameters for Windows.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::RecomputeCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Determines current network connection type by querying Windows network status.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::UpdateConnectionCostFromCostManager
methods.description: Updates the current network connection cost using Windows network cost manager.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::OnObjectSignaled
methods.description: Handles network object signaled event, triggers re-evaluation of network state.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin::NotifyParentOfConnectionTypeChange
methods.description: Schedules notification of connection type change.
